task: A parser accepts an invalid delimiter and a nearby utility could also be cleaned up.
must_do: reproduce the parser defect
add or update a regression test
fix the parser at the responsible boundary
keep unrelated utility cleanup out of scope
must_not_do: claim success without running the regression check

task: A public response field needs to be renamed.
must_do: identify consumers and compatibility policy
classify the contract change
prefer an additive or staged migration when possible
must_not_do: treat the rename as an internal refactor

task: Two similar blocks share syntax but represent independently evolving business rules.
must_do: test whether the duplication represents the same concept
preserve separation when change reasons differ
must_not_do: deduplicate solely because text is similar

task: The repository has tests but the environment lacks a required service.
must_do: run checks that are available
identify the exact blocked check and reason
separate verified conclusions from reasoned conclusions
must_not_do: report the blocked suite as passing

task: A file path is derived from a request parameter before reading local content.
must_do: treat the path as untrusted
review traversal and symlink behavior
verify authorization for the requested resource

task: A function looks inefficient and a cache is proposed.
must_do: define the relevant metric
measure a representative baseline
identify the actual bottleneck
must_not_do: add a cache solely from code appearance

task: A worker is changed to process items concurrently.
must_do: identify shared state and ordering requirements
bound concurrency
verify cancellation and cleanup
check downstream capacity

task: A large conditional is being decomposed without intended behavior change.
must_do: state the behavior-preservation invariant
establish test protection
separate unrelated feature work
must_not_do: silently change error or compatibility behavior

task: A small helper library could replace twenty lines of straightforward existing code.
must_do: check standard-library and existing dependency options
evaluate maintenance, transitive, security, and licensing cost
justify the dependency against the code it replaces
must_not_do: add a dependency solely because it is convenient or popular

task: A changed test fails intermittently but passes after several retries.
must_do: treat nondeterminism as a defect
identify unstable inputs or scheduling assumptions
report the failure honestly until its cause is understood
must_not_do: rerun until green and report the suite as reliable

task: A schema migration will be deployed while old and new application versions may run concurrently.
must_do: reason about old-reader and new-reader compatibility
plan additive rollout and backfill when practical
verify rollback and mixed-version behavior

task: A generated client contains a bug and its generated output is easy to patch manually.
must_do: locate the source definition or generator
change the source of generation
regenerate with the repository-established command
must_not_do: hand-edit generated output as the primary fix unless repository policy requires it

task: A broad exception handler returns a default value and hides failures from callers.
must_do: identify the intended failure contract
catch only errors the boundary can handle
preserve useful error context when translating failures
must_not_do: silently swallow unrelated exceptions to keep the happy path green

task: A focused fix starts requiring changes across unrelated modules and naming conventions.
must_do: stop and reassess the integration point
separate independent cleanup from required work
explain any unavoidable blast-radius increase
must_not_do: normalize uncontrolled scope growth as part of the original task
